package.description: Removes photo backgrounds locally, at full resolution and without a watermark.

en-GB.description: Removes photo backgrounds locally, at full resolution and without a watermark.
en-GB.longDescription: CutGeek removes the background from a photo on your own machine and hands it back at the original resolution as a transparent PNG. The free web services downsize the result, watermark it, or keep the full-size version behind a subscription; this one does none of those. It can work through a folder of images in one run. Images are processed locally and never uploaded. An internet connection is only used to download a model when you ask for one, or when you click Check for updates.
en-GB.name: CutGeek
